messages:
samir: Heads-up — we're seeing ALB target registration failures in us-east-1 while autoscaling the GPU inference pool. 503s from the ALB and targets keep getting marked unhealthy during attach.
kelsey: Can you drop the exact AWS error and which private endpoint type this is (interface VPCE / internal ALB / NLB)? Need quota snapshot too.
samir: Error from the control plane when new nodes come up:
```
Error registering targets: TargetGroupLimitExceeded: The maximum number of targets for this load balancer has been reached
RequestId: 1234abcd-xyz
```
Also ran a quick audit: active targets on ALB-ml-prod: 50/50 (hard limit hit). We scaled GPU nodes from 20 -> 80 this morning which triggered mass re-registrations to the private ALB.
maria: Is this an internal ALB fronting the private VPC endpoints? If so the common fixes are: increase target limit with AWS or switch to NLB/IP targets. For interface endpoints (VPCE) we may also hit ENI/vpce limits.
samir: This is an internal ALB with target type = instance, fronting k8s NodePortService -> aws-alb-ingress. The VPCE type is interface, one per service. We're seeing both: target registration errors and a couple of failed ENI attachments in the node bootstrap logs.
jordan-cloudops: Workarounds: 1) Temporarily scale new nodes more slowly so registrations trickle, 2) provision a second ALB in a different AZ and split the NodePort annotation to reduce per-LB targets, 3) convert target type to IP so we register pod IPs (reduces per-instance targets). We should also open quota increases for:
- Targets per load balancer
- Network interfaces / VPCE per AZ (if ENIs failing)
- Target groups per region if relevant
infra-bot: Support case created: SR-2026-98765. Quota increase request submitted for 'Targets per load balancer' in us-east-1. AWS ETA: 24-72 hours. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=SR-2026-98765
oncall: I'll escalate the quota case and mark this P2 (impacting GPU inference autoscale). Adding docs: please post the current manifest/tuning we used for the scale event. I'll follow up with AWS reps.
kelsey: Also think through longer term: for high-cardinality GPU fleets we should prefer NLB+IP targets or split services by ALB to keep per-LB target counts low. I'll draft a short migration playbook (IP targets + pre-warm, or multi-ALB routing) and share.
samir: Copy — next steps for me: (1) slow scale rollout now, (2) add ingress split to a second internal ALB, (3) attach to SR-2026-98765 and push for 48h SLA, (4) share bootstrap logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
